title: The review decision codes and outcome values, the placement of the review facts in the record, and the rwb-decision login name are in no source
source: RWB-E1-054 sections 4, 8, 11 and 12; TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T6.1; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 AC-EXC-P7-002-03, AC-ALT-P7-001-01 and AC-ALT-P7-001-02; Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.5 DP-02 and DP-03; RWB-P5-E1054-CON sections 12.3 and 14
description: The legacy story names the DOCATT decision log entry only and gives no code, final call, action or outcome value for the review action. TSD P7 v2 gives decision_log_entry a decision_code from LOV-DECISION, a final_call, an actions and an outcome column, and T3.2 does not enumerate LOV-DECISION or the final-call list; no source states which code the review completion, the confirm, the correct or the discard carries, which value the final call takes when the item is discarded, or which key names inside actions and outcome carry the document reference, the review status, the review outcome and the field count. Template and Rules R4 and DP-02 fix one login per service and no document states the rwb-decision login name. This one row covers the three missing items for this story.
evidence: RWB-E1-054 section 4 step 7 (the DOCATT entry), section 8 BR6 and BR9 and section 12 (the DOCATT position, no code list); TSD P7 v2 T3.1 DF-DEC-003, DF-DEC-012, DF-DEC-014, DF-DEC-015 and DF-DEC-031 with no value list, T3.2 naming LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-APPROVAL-STATUS, LOV-CAPABILITY and LOV-PRODUCT only, T6.1 giving every RW- role Decision log R; FSD P7 v3 AC-EXC-P7-002-03 (one entry per repeated event, repeat count for R-UNI-40) and AC-ALT-P7-001-02 (the seven field groups) with no code; Template and Rules R4 (one login per service) and DP-02 with no login name anywhere; RWB-P5-E1054-CON section 12.3 declaring the DOCATT record with the type, the item ID and the reviewer, and section 14 giving no code either.
owner_role: Solution architect with the reference-data owner and the ACE team
proposed: Take the review decision codes and the final-call values from LOV-DECISION and the final-call list in force through the reference-data contract of rwb-case, keep DOCATT as the attach code because the document hub contract already declares it, fix the actions and outcome keys as documentRef, reviewStatus, reviewOutcome and fieldCount, allocate the login with the schema rwb_decision in the platform secret store, and settle all three with the reference-data owner before the first joint environment.
